overview: Perissodactyla includes living horses, tapirs and rhinoceroses alongside many extinct branches. Fossils place an early radiation during the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum (PETM), but the sampled record and analyses do not resolve the order's exact origin.

ecology.habitat: Lineage-specific terrestrial habitats; no single order-wide habitat
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial, with strongly divergent limb specializations
ecology.bodySize: Small early forms to giant rhinocerotoids
ecology.guild: Browsers, mixed feeders and grazers in separate lineages
ecology.dietZh: 本页概括所取样支系中的陆生植食性。它不能说明所有后代都具有相同食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 栖地证据因支系而异，所述环境为陆生；现有资料没有为整个奇蹄目指定一种共同栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引资料将本目成员描述为陆生，但不同支系的肢体特化差异明显。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 记录中的形态从早期小型成员到巨型犀形类不等；这是支系间对比，不是整个目的单一测量值。
ecology.guildZh: 所引支系中有食叶者、混合取食者和放牧者。这些取食角色分布于不同支系，并非本目所有成员共有。

traits: Early branches distinguished by subtle dental and cranial characters
Strong lineage-specific divergence of skull, dentition and limbs
evidenceSummary: The PETM occurrence study and broader fossil synthesis trace branching histories across northern continents. They do not date the order's exact origin or establish one way of life for every branch.

title.en: Earliest perissodactyls reveal large-scale dispersals during the PETM
title.zh: Earliest perissodactyls reveal large-scale dispersals during the PETM

scope.zh: 用于本文选取的解剖、关系或时间估计材料，不由此推断完整物种史或分布。

title.en: Evolutionary Transitions in the Fossil Record of Terrestrial Hoofed Mammals
title.zh: Evolutionary Transitions in the Fossil Record of Terrestrial Hoofed Mammals

scope.en: The selected anatomical, relationship or time-estimate material described in this account; no complete species history or distribution is inferred.
scope.zh: 用于本文选取的解剖、关系或时间估计材料，不由此推断完整物种史或分布。

title.en: Perissodactyl evolution
title.zh: Perissodactyl evolution

scope.en: The selected anatomical, relationship or time-estimate material described in this account; no complete species history or distribution is inferred.
scope.zh: 用于本文选取的解剖、关系或时间估计材料，不由此推断完整物种史或分布。

title.en: Living forms differ across a branching order
title.zh: 现生成员形态不同，化石记录呈分支

text.zh: 今天的马、貘和犀牛外形差异很大。早期化石常依靠牙齿和头骨的细微特征区分，灭绝支系又呈现更多变化。它们共同组成分支记录，而不是只通向现生类群的连续队列。
text.en: Horses, tapirs and rhinoceroses look very different today. Early fossils are often separated by finer tooth and skull features, and extinct branches add further variation. Together they form a branching record, not a sequence leading only to the living forms.

title.zh: 71 个末端与 102 个性状仍留下基部争议
title.en: 71 terminals and 102 characters leave basal positions open

text.zh: 最早出现记录研究分析了 71 个末端和 102 个形态性状。基部位置存在不同结果，说明最早取样化石并未解决本目的起源。
text.en: The earliest-occurrence study analyzes 71 terminals and 102 morphological characters. Alternative placements near the base show why the first sampled fossils do not settle the order's origin.

title.zh: 不同支系分别改变牙齿、头骨与四肢
title.en: Separate branches changed teeth, skulls and limbs

text.zh: 奇蹄目的分支历史包含许多灭绝类群。牙齿、头骨和四肢沿不同谱系变化；若把化石排成连续祖先队列，就会掩盖分支格局。
text.en: Many extinct groups sit within the order's branching history. Teeth, skulls and limbs changed along different lineages; arranging fossils as successive ancestors would hide that branching pattern.

title.zh: PETM 期间的扩散不能确定本目起源地
title.en: PETM dispersal does not identify the order's origin

text.zh: 最早取样的奇蹄类记录约为距今 5600 万至 5400 万年（56–54 Ma），处于 PETM 期间。分布支持北美、欧洲和亚洲之间发生快速扩散，但没有确定本目的确切起源地。
text.en: The earliest sampled perissodactyl records fall around 56–54 Ma, during the PETM. Their distribution supports rapid dispersal among North America, Europe and Asia, but does not identify the order's exact place of origin.

readerLimitations.en: This early radiation is reconstructed from sampled fossils and comparative anatomy. Basal placements depend on analysis, and the selected records do not identify direct ancestors, a precise origin date or a complete distribution.
readerLimitations.zh: 早期辐射依据取样化石与比较解剖重建。基部位置取决于分析方式；所选记录不能确定直系祖先、精确起源年代或完整分布。

overviewZh: 奇蹄目包括现生马、貘和犀牛，也包括许多灭绝支系。化石将其早期辐射置于古新世—始新世极热事件（PETM）期间，但取样记录和分析没有解决本目的确切起源。
evidenceSummaryZh: PETM 产出研究与更广泛的化石综述追踪了北方大陆上的分支历史，但没有确定本目的确切起源时间，也没有证明每条支系都具有相同生活方式。
traitsZh: 所引比较研究利用细微的牙齿与头骨性状区分早期支系。
化石记录显示头骨、牙齿和四肢沿不同支系发生明显变化。

overview: Brontotheriidae varied widely in form during the Eocene. Members share cranial and upper-molar features, including a shortened face, but early forms were small while some later species reached rhinoceros size. Frontonasal appendages occur in some species, so the family pattern is not a portrait of every member.
overviewZh: Brontotheriidae 在始新世呈现多样形态。成员共享一些头骨和上臼齿特征，包括缩短的吻部；早期类型较小，部分晚期种达到犀牛大小。额鼻部附属突起只见于部分物种，因此科级特征不能代表每个成员。

ecology.diet: Brontotheres were herbivores; leaf browsing is supported by the sampled teeth.
ecology.habitat: The cited records are from terrestrial Eocene localities; they do not define one habitat for the whole family.
ecology.locomotion: The family is terrestrial, but the cited evidence does not establish one gait for every member.
ecology.bodySize: The documented size range runs from small early forms to rhinoceros-sized later taxa.
ecology.guild: The sampled dental evidence contains a leaf-browsing signal.
ecology.dietZh: 雷兽类是草食动物；取样牙齿支持其取食叶片。
ecology.habitatZh: 所引记录来自始新世陆生化石地点；它们不能界定整个雷兽科共同的单一生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 该科为陆生，但所引证据无法确定所有成员共有的一种步态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 记录的体型范围从早期的小型类型到后期的犀牛大小类群。
ecology.guildZh: 所取样的牙齿证据显示出取食叶片的信号。

traits: The face is shortened from front to back in the family-level diagnosis.
The postorbital part of the skull is elongate.
Upper molars are bunoselenodont, with a W-shaped outer ridge (ectoloph).
Frontonasal appendages occur in some species, not across the family.
evidenceSummary: Mihlbachler's monograph supplies the taxonomy, morphology and distribution summarized here. Size and frontonasal appendages vary among species; dispersal direction and deeper relationships are reconstructions, not shared diagnostic observations.
evidenceSummaryZh: 本页概括的分类、形态和分布依据 Mihlbachler 的专著。体型和额鼻部附属突起因种而异；扩散方向与深层亲缘关系属于重建结果，并非全科共有的诊断观察。

readerLimitations.en: The monograph records smaller early forms, later rhinoceros-sized taxa and appendages present only in some species. Dental browsing signals and terrestrial Eocene localities do not establish one habitat or gait for the whole family.
readerLimitations.zh: 专著记录了早期小型类型、晚期犀牛大小类群，以及只见于部分物种的附属突起。牙齿中的浏览取食信号和始新世陆生地点，不能证明全科共享一种栖地或步态。

traitsZh: 科级鉴定特征包括前后方向缩短的面部。
眼眶之后的颅骨部分较长。
上臼齿呈丘形—月形结构，外侧脊（外脊）呈 W 形。
某些物种具有额鼻部附属结构，但这并非全科共有。

geography: Western Europe (French and British study records)
overview: The Palaeotherium medium sample from La Débruge records wear consistent with leaf browsing and a smaller fruit or abrasive-seed component. British range records describe a separate regional history near the Grande Coupure; they do not turn local losses into a global genus extinction date.

ecology.diet: In sampled Palaeotherium medium, dental wear supports leaf browsing with a smaller fruit or abrasive-seed component.
ecology.habitat: La Débruge is a late Eocene terrestrial locality; tooth wear alone does not reconstruct the animal’s habitat.
ecology.locomotion: The cited dental-wear study does not evaluate gait.
ecology.bodySize: The evidence is for sampled Palaeotherium medium; it does not provide a genus-wide size estimate.
ecology.guild: The sampled Palaeotherium medium population is described as a leaf browser; this is not a genus-wide assignment.
ecology.dietZh: 在取样的 Palaeotherium medium 中，牙齿磨耗支持以浏览取食叶片为主的混合食性，另有较少的果实或具磨蚀性的种子成分。
ecology.habitatZh: La Débruge 是晚始新世陆生化石地点；仅凭齿面磨耗不能重建动物的生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引牙齿磨损研究没有评估步态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 证据仅涉及取样的 Palaeotherium medium，不能提供整个属的体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 所取样的 Palaeotherium medium 种群被描述为食叶者；这一归类不适用于整个属。

traits: The molars have high occlusal relief.
Worn cusps include both sharp and rounded forms.
Wear facets are consistent with both shearing and grinding plant foods.
evidenceSummary: Joomun and colleagues study dental wear in one species and locality. Hooker and colleagues chart British regional occurrences. Together they do not establish a complete global Palaeotherium range or a single extinction boundary.
overviewZh: 来自 La Débruge 的 Palaeotherium medium 样本，其磨耗与以取食叶片为主、少量果实或具磨蚀性种子的混合食性相符。英国分布记录呈现的是 Grande Coupure 附近另一段区域历史，不能将局部消失改写为该属的全球灭绝年代。
evidenceSummaryZh: Joomun 等人研究一个物种和地点的牙齿磨耗；Hooker 等人绘制英国区域产出图。两者合起来仍不能确定 Palaeotherium 的完整全球分布或单一灭绝界线。

readerSources.title: Dental wear variation and implications for diet: An example from Eocene perissodactyls (Mammalia)

scope.en: Joomun et al. (2008), pp. 92–106, Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–4: dental wear in the La Débruge Palaeotherium medium sample and the resulting dietary interpretation.
scope.zh: Joomun 等（2008），第 92–106 页、图 1–8 与表 1–4：La Débruge 的 Palaeotherium medium 样本牙齿磨耗及据此作出的食性解释。

readerSources.title: Eocene–Oligocene mammalian faunal turnover in the Hampshire Basin, UK: calibration to the global time scale and the major cooling event

scope.en: Hooker et al. (2004), pp. 161–172, Figures 2–4 and the mammal range chart: British regional records and losses around the Grande Coupure, not a global extinction date.
scope.zh: Hooker 等（2004），第 161–172 页、图 2–4 与哺乳动物分布图：英国区域记录及 Grande Coupure 前后的消失，不是全球灭绝年代。

title.en: Separate a tooth-wear sample from regional history
title.zh: 把牙齿样本与区域历史分开

text.en: The Palaeotherium medium sample from La Débruge records wear consistent with leaf browsing and a smaller fruit or abrasive-seed component. British range records describe a separate regional history near the Grande Coupure; they do not turn local losses into a global genus extinction date.
text.zh: 来自 La Débruge 的 Palaeotherium medium 样本，其磨耗与以取食叶片为主、少量果实或具磨蚀性种子的混合食性相符。英国分布记录呈现的是 Grande Coupure 附近另一段区域历史，不能将局部消失改写为该属的全球灭绝年代。

title.en: Two sources answer different questions
title.zh: 两项来源回答不同问题

text.en: Joomun and colleagues study dental wear in one species and locality. Hooker and colleagues chart British regional occurrences. Together they do not establish a complete global Palaeotherium range or a single extinction boundary.
text.zh: Joomun 等人研究一个物种和地点的牙齿磨耗；Hooker 等人绘制英国区域产出图。两者合起来仍不能确定 Palaeotherium 的完整全球分布或单一灭绝界线。

traitsZh: 臼齿具有较高的咬合面起伏。
磨耗的齿尖既有尖锐型，也有圆钝型。
磨耗面特征符合对植物性食物同时进行剪切和研磨。

geography: Badlands National Park, South Dakota (sampled M. planifrons)
overview: Metamynodon planifrons is the subject of a comparative test of semi-aquatic locomotion. Its anatomy and depositional setting inform that hypothesis for this species; they do not support a family-wide swamp-rhino label.

ecology.diet: Herbivorous; diet not tested in the locomotor study
ecology.locomotion: Semi-aquatic inference from comparative anatomy and deposits
ecology.bodySize: Large M. planifrons sample; genus-wide mass not generalized
ecology.guild: No feeding guild assigned beyond the bounded locomotor inference
ecology.dietZh: 本页将 M. planifrons 描述为植食性，但所引运动研究没有检验食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 所取样的 Metamynodon planifrons 材料与奥雷尔阶河道砂岩有关。这种沉积关联本身不能确定惯常栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 对所研究 M. planifrons 材料的解剖比较和沉积背景支持半水生运动推断，但两者都没有直接记录行为。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 本页涉及大型 M. planifrons 材料，并未将体重估计推广到整个属。
ecology.guildZh: 运动比较没有在有限的运动推断之外指定取食功能群。

traits: High-positioned orbits
Reduced thoracic neural spines
Limb-lever proportions differing from more terrestrial amynodontids
evidenceSummary: Wall and Heinbaugh use comparative anatomy and deposits to test semi-aquatic movement. The study does not observe behavior, test diet, assign a feeding guild or estimate mass across the genus.

title.en: One species in a test of semi-aquatic movement
title.zh: 以一个物种检验半水生运动

text.en: Metamynodon planifrons is the subject of a comparative test of semi-aquatic locomotion. Its anatomy and depositional setting inform that hypothesis for this species; they do not support a family-wide swamp-rhino label.
text.zh: Metamynodon planifrons 是一项半水生运动比较研究的对象。其解剖和沉积背景为这个物种的假说提供信息，但不能据此把整个科称为沼泽犀牛。

title.en: Orbits, neural spines and limb proportions
title.zh: 眼眶、神经棘与肢骨比例

text.en: In the studied M. planifrons material, the orbits sit high on the skull and the thoracic neural spines are reduced. Its limb-lever proportions differ from those of the more terrestrial amynodontids included in the comparison.
text.zh: 在所研究的 M. planifrons 材料中，眼眶位于头骨较高处，胸椎神经棘缩短。其肢骨杠杆比例不同于比较中纳入的、更偏陆生的两栖犀类。

title.en: Channel sandstones are depositional context
title.zh: 河道砂岩提供沉积背景

text.en: The sampled material is associated with Orellan channel sandstones. This setting contributes to the movement interpretation but does not directly establish habitual habitat or behavior.
text.zh: 所取样材料与奥雷尔阶河道砂岩有关。这一背景参与运动解释，但不能直接确定惯常栖地或行为。

title.en: A semi-aquatic interpretation, not observed behavior
title.zh: 半水生解释不是观察到的行为

text.en: Wall and Heinbaugh use comparative anatomy and deposits to test semi-aquatic movement. The study does not observe behavior, test diet, assign a feeding guild or estimate mass across the genus.
text.zh: Wall 和 Heinbaugh 通过比较解剖和沉积背景检验半水生运动。研究没有观察行为、检验食性、指定取食功能群，也没有估算全属体重。

title.en: Locomotor adaptations in Metamynodon planifrons compared to other amynodontids (Perissodactyla, Rhinocerotoidea)
title.zh: Locomotor adaptations in Metamynodon planifrons compared to other amynodontids (Perissodactyla, Rhinocerotoidea)

scope.en: Comparative anatomy tests semi-aquatic locomotion in M. planifrons; behaviour is not directly observed.
scope.zh: 比较解剖用于检验 M. planifrons 的半水生运动方式；行为并未直接观察。

title.en: Amynodontidae
title.zh: Amynodontidae

scope.en: Provides family-level amynodont context; it does not replace the comparative locomotor test for M. planifrons.
scope.zh: 提供两栖犀科的一般背景；它不能替代对 M. planifrons 运动方式的比较检验。

overviewZh: M. planifrons 的眼眶、胸椎神经棘和肢骨比例被用于检验半水生运动假说。
evidenceSummaryZh: 解剖比较与河道砂岩背景支持半水生推断；行为未被直接观察，也不提供属级体重估计。
traitsZh: 所取样头骨的眼眶位置较高，这是运动研究比较的特征之一。
研究描述了所取样材料中胸椎区域缩短的神经棘。
所取样的肢骨杠杆比例不同于作为对照的、更偏陆生的两栖犀类。

overview: This Oligocene Asian account samples six Paraceratherium species. A 155-character analysis places the approximately 26.5 Ma specimen LX1808 within a monophyletic genus, although finer relationships depend on the matrix. Its skull, mandible and neck vertebrae support a giant animal with a long neck and long limbs.
overviewZh: 本页介绍渐新世亚洲副巨犀属，分析取样了六个物种。155 项性状分析将年代约为 26.5 Ma 的 LX1808 标本置于单系属内，但更细的亲缘关系取决于矩阵。其头骨、下颌和颈椎支持其体型巨大、颈部与四肢较长。

ecology.diet: A large terrestrial herbivore; feeding height is inferred from neck and body form, not measured.
ecology.habitat: Oligocene Asian woodland–grassland mosaics are reported for sampled localities; settings vary by locality.
ecology.locomotion: The long limbs do not fit the elephant-like, short-limbed graviportal analogy rejected in the cited study.
ecology.bodySize: Giant-bodied; the profile does not infer a more precise mass.
ecology.guild: A large browser is an anatomical inference; diet was not directly measured.
ecology.dietZh: 一种大型陆生草食动物；其取食高度是根据颈部和身体形态推断的，并未测量。
ecology.habitatZh: 所取样地点记录了渐新世亚洲林地—草地镶嵌景观；不同地点的环境各异。
ecology.locomotionZh: 其长肢与象类短肢、重型承重动物式的类比不符；所引研究也否定了这种类比。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 体型巨大；该简介没有推算更精确的体重。
ecology.guildZh: 大型食叶者是根据解剖特征作出的推断；并未直接测量其食性。

traits: Giant skull and body size
Long, flexible neck supported by cervical anatomy
Long limbs rather than stubby graviportal limbs
Species diagnoses use cranial and dental characters
evidenceSummary: Deng and colleagues document LX1808, its diagnosis, a 155-character analysis and an occurrence map. The analysis samples six species and supports a monophyletic genus; dispersal through the Tibetan region, palaeoelevation and feeding height remain inferences.

readerLimitations.en: LX1808 is one point occurrence, not a global first or last appearance. Localities span the Mongolian Plateau, northwestern China, Kazakhstan and Pakistan; a route through the Tibetan region and palaeoelevation are reconstructed. Herbivory is supported, but browsing height and one habitat for all species are not established.
readerLimitations.zh: LX1808 是一个地点的产出记录，不是全球首现或末现。地点横跨蒙古高原、中国西北、哈萨克斯坦和巴基斯坦；经由青藏地区的路线和古海拔属于重建。食草解释有依据，但取食高度及全属共同栖地尚未确定。

evidenceSummaryZh: Deng 等人记录了 LX1808、其鉴定特征、155 项性状分析和产出分布图。分析取样六个物种并支持该属为单系群；经由青藏地区的扩散、古海拔和取食高度仍属推断。
traitsZh: 头骨和身体体型巨大。
颈椎解剖特征支持其具有长而灵活的颈部。
肢体较长，而非粗短的重型承重型肢体。
物种鉴定依据颅骨和牙齿特征。

overview: The dental-wear sample labels include Chalicotherium goldfussi and the historical combination Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande. Keeping those source names visible prevents material identified under different names from being treated as one undifferentiated species.
overviewZh: 牙齿磨耗样本标签包括 Chalicotherium goldfussi 和历史组合 Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande。保留来源名称，可避免把不同名称下的材料当作同一个未经区分的物种。

ecology.diet: Wear evidence supports browsing, with abrasive bark or twig material among the proposed foods.
ecology.habitat: The samples come from Miocene sites in southern Germany. Diet alone does not identify the habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Posture is reconstructed from limb anatomy, not observed directly.
ecology.bodySize: The sampled animals are large chalicotheriines; the cited study does not give a genus-wide mass estimate.
ecology.guild: The dietary evidence suggests a browser with mixed food textures; the full feeding guild remains an interpretation.
ecology.dietZh: 磨耗证据支持其取食叶片、枝条等；被提出的食物中包括带磨蚀性的树皮或细枝材料。
ecology.habitatZh: 样本来自德国南部的中新世遗址。仅凭食性不能确定生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 姿势是根据肢骨解剖结构重建的，并非直接观察所得。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所取样的动物属于大型爪兽亚科；所引研究没有给出该属整体的体重估计。
ecology.guildZh: 食性证据提示其为取食多种不同质地食物的食叶动物；完整的摄食生态类群仍属解释。

traits: Large terminal toe bones interpreted as claws
Short hind limbs in the sampled chalicotheriines
Posture and claw use are functional reconstructions
evidenceSummary: The primary study combines mesowear and microwear and states the historical names attached to its samples. Tooth wear supports dietary interpretations; posture and claw function depend on anatomical reconstruction.
evidenceSummaryZh: 主研究结合中磨耗和微磨耗，并说明样本所用的历史名称。牙齿磨耗支持食性解释；姿势与爪的功能则依赖解剖重建。

title.en: Two sample names stay distinct in this genus account
title.zh: 这份属级档案保留两种样本名称

text.en: The dental-wear sample labels include Chalicotherium goldfussi and the historical combination Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande. Keeping those source names visible prevents material identified under different names from being treated as one undifferentiated species.
text.zh: 牙齿磨耗样本标签包括 Chalicotherium goldfussi 和历史组合 Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande。保留来源名称，可避免把不同名称下的材料当作同一个未经区分的物种。

title.en: Wear supports browse-dominated mixed feeding
title.zh: 磨耗支持以浏览取食为主的混合食性

text.en: Mesowear and microwear in the studied southern German Miocene samples support browse-dominated feeding with mixed food textures. Bark or twigs are among the proposed abrasive foods. This is an inference from tooth wear, not a directly observed meal.
text.zh: 德国南部中新世样本的中磨耗和微磨耗支持以浏览取食为主、食物质地混合的解释。树皮或嫩枝是提出的磨蚀性食物之一。这是牙齿磨耗推断，并非直接观察到的一餐。

title.en: Claws and posture are functional reconstructions
title.zh: 爪与姿势属于功能重建

text.en: The studied large chalicotheriines preserve large terminal toe bones interpreted as claws and shortened hind limbs. Upright posture and claw use are reconstructions from anatomy, not observed behavior.
text.zh: 所研究的大型爪兽亚科材料保存了被解释为爪的大型趾末端骨和较短后肢。直立姿势与爪的用途是根据解剖作出的重建，并非观察到的行为。

title.en: Feeding ecology of the Chalicotheriidae (Mammalia, Perissodactyla, Ancylopoda): results from dental micro- and mesowear analyses
title.zh: Feeding ecology of the Chalicotheriidae (Mammalia, Perissodactyla, Ancylopoda): results from dental micro- and mesowear analyses

scope.en: Schulz et al. (2007), pp. 5?23, Figures 1, 5 and 6 and Tables 2?7: sample names, dental-wear evidence, browse and bark/twig interpretation, ungual phalanges and reconstructed posture.

readerLimitations.en: These conclusions are tied to sampled Miocene localities in southern Germany and the names used in the study. They do not establish a genus-wide mass estimate, global range or complete feeding guild.
readerLimitations.zh: 这些结论仅适用于德国南部中新世取样地点及研究采用的名称，不能据此确定整个属的体重估计、全球分布或完整取食功能群。

traitsZh: 末端趾骨较大，被解释为爪。
所取样爪兽亚科成员的后肢较短。
姿势和爪的用途属于功能性重建。

geography: Central and western Europe (MN3–MN9 record discussed)
overview: Kaiser analyzed 35 cheek teeth of Anchitherium aurelianense from Sandelzhausen; their mesowear supports browse-dominated mixed feeding, not a uniform pure-browser model. The separate MN3–MN9 record describes a European biochronological sample, not the genus's complete global ecology or range.

ecology.diet: Mesowear on 35 cheek teeth supports browse-dominated mixed feeding rather than a uniform pure-browser model at this locality.
ecology.habitat: The dietary sample comes from Sandelzhausen in a warm-temperate woodland context; it does not summarize habitat across the genus.
ecology.locomotion: The cited diagnosis records a three-toed manus and reduced fifth metacarpal; running performance is not tested.
ecology.bodySize: The selected evidence provides no single genus-wide mass estimate.
ecology.guild: The sampled teeth support browse-dominated mixed feeding; they do not assign one feeding guild to every Anchitherium population.
ecology.dietZh: 对 35 颗颊齿的中齿磨损分析支持其以取食树叶为主的混合食性；在该地点，这不支持所有个体都为纯食叶者的统一模式。
ecology.habitatZh: 摄食研究样本来自 Sandelzhausen，当地处于暖温带林地环境；它不能概括整个属的栖息环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引鉴别描述记录了三趾的前足和缩小的第五掌骨；研究未检验其奔跑能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所选证据没有提供适用于整个属的单一体重估计。
ecology.guildZh: 取样牙齿支持以浏览取食树叶为主的混合食性；据此不能为每个 Anchitherium 种群都指定同一种摄食功能类群。

traits: Low-crowned lophodont cheek teeth
Tridactyl manus with reduced fifth metacarpal
Dental wear more abrasive than a pure-browser model predicts
evidenceSummary: Kaiser analyzes 35 Anchitherium aurelianense cheek teeth from Sandelzhausen. The study's dietary result is local to that species and sample; the European MN3–MN9 record supplies regional biochronological context, not complete global endpoints or a precise date for every fossil.

title.en: Thirty-five cheek teeth show mixed wear signals
title.zh: 35 枚颊齿呈现混合磨耗信号

text.en: Kaiser measured mesowear on 35 cheek teeth from Anchitherium aurelianense at Sandelzhausen. The pattern supports browse-dominated mixed feeding rather than a uniform pure-browser model. It applies to one species at one locality; the study does not separate every influence on diet or generalize the result to the genus.
text.zh: Kaiser 对 Sandelzhausen 的 35 枚 Anchitherium aurelianense 颊齿测量了中观磨耗。结果支持以浏览取食为主的混合食性，而非统一的纯食叶者模式。结论仅适用于一个地点的一个物种；研究没有分离食性的所有影响，也未将结果推广到整个属。

title.en: Hand anatomy and European MN3–MN9 context
title.zh: 手部解剖与欧洲 MN3–MN9 背景

text.en: The cited diagnosis records low-crowned lophodont cheek teeth and a three-toed manus with a reduced fifth metacarpal. MN3–MN9 supplies a European biochronological context, not a direct date for each fossil or a complete global Anchitherium range.
text.zh: 所引鉴别描述记录了低冠脊褶型颊齿，以及三趾、第五掌骨缩小的前足。MN3–MN9 提供欧洲生物年代背景，并非每件化石的直接定年或 Anchitherium 的完整全球分布。

title.en: Anchitherium aurelianense (Equidae, Mammalia): a brachydont “dirty browser” in the community of herbivorous large mammals from Sandelzhausen (Miocene, Germany)
title.zh: Anchitherium aurelianense (Equidae, Mammalia): a brachydont “dirty browser” in the community of herbivorous large mammals from Sandelzhausen (Miocene, Germany)

scope.en: Recorded reader-passage locators: supports; pages: 131–140; figure: Figures 1–3; Table 1; quoteLocator: Diagnosis and European MN3–MN9 context (pp. 131–132); 35-tooth mesowear result and discussion (pp. 133–139)
scope.zh: 读者段落的原始定位：supports; pages: 131–140; figure: Figures 1–3; Table 1; quoteLocator: Diagnosis and European MN3–MN9 context (pp. 131–132); 35-tooth mesowear result and discussion (pp. 133–139)

overviewZh: Kaiser 分析了 Sandelzhausen 的 35 枚 Anchitherium aurelianense 颊齿；中观磨耗支持以浏览取食为主的混合食性，不支持统一的纯食叶者模式。另列的 MN3–MN9 记录描述欧洲生物年代学样本，并非该属完整的全球生态或分布。
evidenceSummaryZh: Kaiser 分析了 Sandelzhausen 的 35 枚 Anchitherium aurelianense 颊齿。食性结果仅适用于该物种和样本；欧洲 MN3–MN9 提供区域生物年代背景，并非完整的全球端点或每件化石的精确年代。
traitsZh: 所引鉴别描述记录了低冠、脊褶型颊齿。
所描述的前足为三趾，第五掌骨缩小。
牙齿磨耗比纯食叶者模型的预期更具磨蚀性，与样本所支持的混合取食相符。

regionalRanges.label: North American tribe-level range
regionalRanges.basis: The North American review and its tribe-level figure place the represented hipparionin record from approximately 17 to 2 Ma; this remains a regional review-matrix envelope.

regionalRanges.label: Old World first dispersal
regionalRanges.basis: The oldest well-supported Old World dispersal window is represented by early Hippotherium records in the Vienna Basin.

regionalRanges.label: Latest Old World regional records
regionalRanges.basis: Terminal records vary by lineage and region; the review places the latest Chinese and African hipparionins around or below 1 Ma rather than at the Holocene boundary.

overview: Hipparionini is an extinct horse tribe whose members retained three toes while diversifying into several Old World genus-level groups. Diet, body size and habitat vary among lineages and through time, so no one species profile represents the tribe.

ecology.habitat: Forest, woodland and open settings depending on lineage and time
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial equine locomotion with persistent side toes
ecology.dietZh: 旧世界综述记录了以浏览取食为主、混合取食和放牧的支系。这些食性对应不同的样本与分支。
ecology.habitatZh: 本页记录不同支系和时期的森林、林地及开阔环境，没有为整个族指定一种栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所述三趾马类为陆生马科动物，并保留侧趾；这不表示每条支系的足部比例都相同。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 综述材料记录了支系间明显的体型差异，从小型到大型形态均有。
ecology.guildZh: 现有比较显示植食性支系具有生态多样性，并非共享同一种功能群。

traits: Persistent tridactyly
Hypsodont teeth in many lineages
Substantial body-size and dietary variation
evidenceSummary: The record separates a broad North American tribe-level history from an Old World dispersal interval of 11.4–11.0 Ma and later Eurasian and African occurrences. The underlying sources retain narrower windows; they do not make one continuous timeline or prove a single migration route.

title.en: Three toes persisted while diets diversified
title.zh: 三趾延续，食性却不断分化

text.en: Hipparionins retained three toes, while many lineages evolved high-crowned teeth. The reviewed Old World forms range from browsing to mixed feeding and grazing, and body size and foot proportions also vary. These traits belong to different branches and settings, not one fixed lifestyle for every member.
text.zh: Hipparionini 保留三趾特征，许多支系则演化出高冠齿。旧世界综述中的类群从浏览取食到混合取食、放牧均有记录，体型和足部比例也有差异。这些性状属于不同支系与环境，并非所有成员共有的固定生活方式。

title.en: Keep North American and Old World windows separate
title.zh: 分别看待北美与旧大陆的时间窗口

text.en: The atlas distinguishes a broad North American tribe-level history from the Old World dispersal interval of 11.4–11.0 Ma and later Eurasian and African records. Separate, narrower windows remain in the underlying evidence. These sampled records do not form one continuous range or establish a single migration route.
text.zh: 图谱将较广的北美族级历史，与 11.4–11.0 Ma 的旧大陆扩散区间及其后欧亚、非洲记录分开。底层证据保留了更窄的独立时间窗口。这些取样记录既不构成连续分布，也没有确定单一迁徙路线。

overviewZh: Hipparionini 是已灭绝的马族，成员在分化为若干旧大陆属级类群时保留了三趾特征。食性、体型和生境随支系与时期而异，不能用一个物种画像代表全族。
evidenceSummaryZh: 资料将较广的北美族级历史，与 11.4–11.0 Ma 的旧大陆扩散区间及其后欧亚、非洲产出分开呈现。底层来源还保留更窄的时间窗口；这些记录不构成一条连续时间线，也不能证明唯一迁徙路线。
traitsZh: 三趾（tridactyly）特征在所取样的三趾马记录中持续出现。
许多支系演化出高冠齿；本页没有把这一性状赋予所有成员。
综述中的分支在体型和食性上各有差异，不应将它们压成全族统一的生活方式。

overview: Florida isotope studies portray sampled Teleoceras populations mainly as terrestrial, while a limited-mobility, wet-habitat signal is strongest for T. major at Ashfall. The evidence differs by locality and does not support one behavior for every population.

ecology.diet: Dental and isotope evidence supports grazing or mixed feeding depending on locality; no single diet describes all samples.
ecology.habitat: Evidence includes open Florida settings and the Ashfall watering-hole landscape, which are distinct local records.
ecology.locomotion: Shortened limb and foot bones are preserved, but semi-aquatic interpretation is restricted to the Ashfall evidence rather than assigned genus-wide.
ecology.bodySize: Ashfall estimates for T. major are near 785–1,110 kg; they are population- and site-specific estimates.
ecology.guild: Grazer or mixed-feeder roles are inferred locally from teeth and isotopes.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿和同位素证据显示，取食可能因地点而为食草或混合食；没有一种食谱能概括所有样本。
ecology.habitatZh: 证据分别来自佛罗里达的开阔环境和 Ashfall 的水塘景观，二者属于不同地点记录。
ecology.locomotionZh: 化石保存了缩短的肢骨和足骨，但半水生解释限于 Ashfall 的证据，不能推广到整个属。
ecology.bodySizeZh: Ashfall 的 T. major 体重估计约为 785–1,110 千克；这是特定种群和地点的估值。
ecology.guildZh: 根据不同地点的牙齿和同位素，局部推测其生态角色为食草或混合取食。

traits: Shortened limb and foot bones are preserved.
T. major at Ashfall is described as barrel-bodied.
Hypsodont molars are present.
Lower second incisors show sexual dimorphism.
evidenceSummary: Florida and Ashfall studies yield different ecological signals. Body shape alone does not decide behavior, and the strongest Ashfall interpretation remains bounded to T. major at that locality.
overviewZh: 佛罗里达同位素研究显示，所取样的 Teleoceras 种群主要为陆生；活动范围有限、偏湿地环境的信号则在 Ashfall 的 T. major 中最强。证据因地点而异，不支持把一种行为套用于所有种群。
traitsZh: 标本保存有缩短的肢骨和足骨。
Ashfall 的 T. major 被描述为桶状身躯。
具有高冠齿臼齿。
下颌第二门齿存在雌雄差异。
evidenceSummaryZh: 佛罗里达与 Ashfall 的研究得出不同生态信号。仅凭体形不能确定行为；最强的 Ashfall 解释仍限于该地点的 T. major。

overview: Coelodonta includes species recorded from the Tibetan Plateau and East Asia to northern Eurasia, but its ecology was not uniform. Evidence about C. antiquitatis remains separate from isotope results for other species, including C. nihowanensis.

ecology.diet: Typical grazing in C. antiquitatis; mixed feeding in some C. nihowanensis samples
ecology.habitat: Cold dry steppe for C. antiquitatis; other species and regions vary
ecology.bodySize: Large; about 2900 kg reviewed for C. antiquitatis
ecology.guild: Cold-steppe grazer in C. antiquitatis, not a genus-wide constant
ecology.dietZh: 综述将 C. antiquitatis 描述为典型放牧者；部分 C. nihowanensis 种群的同位素样本则指向混合取食。两项结果都不能套用于该属所有物种。
ecology.habitatZh: 寒冷、干燥草原的解释针对 C. antiquitatis。其他 Coelodonta 物种和地区有所不同。
ecology.locomotionZh: 本页将 Coelodonta 描述为陆生、重型承重型。这种体型描述不能确定全属行为完全相同。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 综述给出的 C. antiquitatis 体重估值约为 2,900 kg。这是物种层面的估值，不是全属体重。
ecology.guildZh: 所引综述中的寒冷草原放牧画像适用于 C. antiquitatis，不代表所有 Coelodonta 物种。

traits: Long hair and dense underwool in C. antiquitatis
Low head posture and long nasal horn in C. antiquitatis
High-crowned teeth associated with abrasive grazing
evidenceSummary: The ecological review compares species and regions; a separate genomic study directly dates one C. antiquitatis individual to 14.4 ka. These sources do not establish a continuous genus-wide history or an exact global extinction boundary.

title.en: Cold-steppe traits belong to C. antiquitatis
title.zh: 寒冷草原特征属于 C. antiquitatis

text.en: The review describes C. antiquitatis as cold-adapted and grazing, with long hair, dense underwool, a low head posture, a long nasal horn and high-crowned teeth. Isotope samples from some C. nihowanensis populations instead indicate mixed feeding. These findings vary by species and place.
text.zh: 综述将 C. antiquitatis 描述为适应寒冷环境的放牧者，并列出长毛、浓密底绒、低头姿态、长鼻角和高冠齿。部分 C. nihowanensis 种群的同位素样本则指向混合取食。结果随物种和地点而异。

title.en: Two dated records do not make a continuous range
title.zh: 两个有年代的记录不构成连续分布

text.en: The review identifies C. thibetana at 5.08 million years ago (5.08 Ma) as the earliest known genus record. A separate genomic study directly dates one C. antiquitatis individual to 14.4 thousand years ago (14.4 ka). These are one reviewed early occurrence and one dated late individual, not proof of continuous presence or the genus’s global last appearance.
text.zh: 综述将距今 508 万年（5.08 Ma）的 C. thibetana 列为目前已知最早的属级记录。另一项基因组研究直接测定了一只距今 1.44 万年（14.4 ka）的 C. antiquitatis 个体。这分别是一条经综述的早期产出和一只直接测年的晚期个体，并非连续存在的证据，也不能确定该属的全球末次出现。

title.en: Ma et al. (2024), Coelodonta paleoecology across Eurasia
title.zh: Ma 等（2024），欧亚披毛犀属古生态综述

scope.en: Species-level ecology and geography across the genus, including morphology and isotope comparisons of C. antiquitatis and C. nihowanensis; Figures 1–6 and Tables 1–2. The review supports regional variation, not one ecology shared by every species.
scope.zh: 属内物种层级的生态与地理综述，包括 C. antiquitatis 和 C. nihowanensis 的形态及同位素比较；图 1–6、表 1–2。该综述支持区域差异，不支持所有物种共享同一生态。

title.en: Guðjónsdóttir et al. (2026), one directly dated woolly rhinoceros genome
title.zh: Guðjónsdóttir 等（2026），一只直接测年的披毛犀基因组

scope.en: One directly dated 14.4 ka C. antiquitatis individual, its genome-wide diversity and runs-of-homozygosity analysis, Figures 1–3 and supplementary tables. This late individual is not a genus-wide global last appearance.
scope.zh: 一只直接测年为 14.4 ka 的 C. antiquitatis 个体、其全基因组多样性与纯合片段分析、图 1–3 和补充表格。这只晚期个体不能代表该属的全球末次出现。

overviewZh: Coelodonta 包括见于青藏高原、东亚至欧亚大陆北部的物种，但其生态并不一致。有关 C. antiquitatis 的证据应与其他物种（包括 C. nihowanensis）的同位素结果分开看待。
evidenceSummaryZh: 综述比较不同物种和地区；基因组研究直接测定一只 C. antiquitatis 个体，年代为 14.4 ka。
traitsZh: 综述描述 C. antiquitatis 具有长毛和浓密底绒。
低头姿态和长鼻角属于 C. antiquitatis 的描述。
综述将高冠齿与所讨论物种的磨蚀性放牧联系起来。
